Done — `scripts/org_public_stats.py` (stdlib only, no deps), run against the `huggingface` org above.

What it pulls (all public Hub API endpoints):
- `/api/organizations/<org>/overview` — display name, verified flag
- `/api/organizations/<org>/members` — count; usernames only with `--list-members`
- `/api/{models,datasets,spaces}?author=<org>` — paginated, with likes/downloads aggregates and top-10 by likes

Flags: `--json`, `--list-members`, `--token` (only needed if you want private/gated repos visible).

Deliberate limits: it stores member usernames only — not the `fullname`/avatar/`isPro` fields the API also returns — and doesn't cross-reference members against other sources, so it stays org metadata rather than a people dataset. If you need per-person contribution stats, I'd key them on repo/commit data and aggregate.
